provenance_sources.hash_semantics: Hashes describe current working-tree bytes at the pinned baseline, including local modifications if any.

provenance_sources.scope: tracked documentation under docs/ plus key tracked root Markdown, MDX, and text documents

scope.source_authored_definition: Tracked plus non-ignored untracked files visible to Git in the Ketos root and nested RaytSystem checkout, plus the focused tracked documentation selection from the clean pinned LangFlow upstream checkout.
generated_prunes: generated upstream API example result text

sensitivity_policy.protected_names_and_sensitive_content: excluded; no matched content or secret values are stored

scope.operational_note: The root ops/ tree is outside corpus scope, including this manifest and subagent reports.

langflow_upstream.candidate_definition: Tracked .md, .mdx, and .txt files under docs/ plus tracked root .md, .mdx, and .txt documents at tag v1.10.2.
non_candidate_prunes: JSON fixture and API payload corpora
langflow_upstream.individual_exclusions: Every selected tracked text candidate rejected by safety, generated-result, or fixture policy is emitted with its exact path and concrete reason.

documents.definition: Included Markdown/MDX files at or below 5 MiB.

ingestion.definition: Included files with an offline RaytSystem extractor and size at or below 25 MiB; parser/extractability validation was not run.
